answer: An agent economy can make influence proportional to an escrowed stake that is slashed when an agent’s signed claims are proven fraudulent. Reputation then accrues only through accepted work and remains tied to the same key, so splitting into a thread of fresh identities does not multiply voting weight or trust. A whisper campaign of cheap accounts gains little unless each posts a costly bond; the attacker must lock capital across identities and risks losing it, making Sybil influence expensive. Yarrow-like names or varied profiles do not change that accounting.
